notes.content:

We’ve released an update with the following changes:
[olist]
The hitbox for Thunder during the appearance of the Adv. Thunder Machine lasted about 0.5 seconds longer than intended, which did not match the visuals.

Adjusted the railgun’s charge completion sound.
[/olist]

notes.title: Startup Troubleshooting
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45141766/db61c3131b266783beb49c76604dbaf9fb54a3bd.png

If you're experiencing issues right after launching the game—such as no sound or controller input not working—it may be caused by external software or configuration conflicts. Below are some common cases and how to address them.

No Sound

Some antivirus or security software (e.g., Norton) may block the game's audio output, preventing sound from playing properly.
Additionally, running DAW software or virtual audio devices can interfere with normal sound playback.

How to Fix

 Add the game’s executable to your antivirus or security software’s exception list.
 Try temporarily disabling the antivirus software.
 Restarting your PC may also resolve the issue.
 Close any music production software or virtual audio drivers.


Controller Not Working

If you're using any of the following controllers, Steam Input compatibility issues may be causing the game to behave unexpectedly:

 Nintendo Switch Pro Controller
 PlayStation 5 (DualSense) Controller


Examples of Symptoms

 Controller input works intermittently
 Button mappings are incorrect
 Stick inputs behave erratically


How to Fix
In the Steam client, go to Settings → Controller → General Controller Settings, and try disabling Steam Input support for your controller.
